question: With which of the following states is the ‘Mando’ festival associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __Goa.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mando Festival is celebrated in Goa.
 
• Mando Festival__
 __
 
• ​Mando is a beautiful dance performance.
 
• Its theme is usually of love - bitter and sweet passion which is in slow and deliberate motion and is well expressed through beautiful movements of words and dance.
 
• Young men and women dance to the beat of romantic tunes of Ghumot (mud percussion instrument) and violin.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__** 

__
 
• Please do not confuse this with the Mandu Festival of Madhya Pradesh. Mando festival is celebrated in Goa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Sao Joao festival__ 

 __
 
• It is celebrated in Goa to pay tribute to St. John the Baptist.

 
 
• St. John was the relative of Mother Mary.
 
 
 
• It is held at the beginning of the monsoon, on June 24.
 
 
 
• Shigmo__
 
 
• It is celebrated in Goa as one of the prominent festivals of the Konkani Hindu community.
